name: PianoFlow: Piano & MIDI
subtitle: Play, practice & record
promotionalText: Make every note yours. Play an expressive 88-key piano, follow sheet music, build your rhythm, and keep your performances on iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo.
description:
Play, practice, and record on an 88-key piano wherever you are.

PianoFlow brings a full keyboard, guided practice, scrolling sheet music, MIDI input, and a recording studio to iPhone and iPad. It adapts to the inner and outer displays of iPhone Duo.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Play chords and glissandos with multi-touch controls. Move from A0 to C8 using octave shortcuts and a range slider. Adjust key width, note labels, volume, and touch feedback. Add sustain, see the chords you play, and keep time with the metronome.

PRACTICE AT YOUR PACE
Explore scales, arpeggios, chords, and familiar melodies with highlighted keys and scrolling sheet music. Practice your left hand, right hand, or both. Rhythm coach adds a count-in and note timing feedback. Set a tempo goal and track daily progress on your device.

BRING YOUR OWN MUSIC
Import a Standard MIDI file from Files, choose its tracks, and assign parts to each hand. Connect a compatible USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard for velocity-sensitive playing and sustain-pedal input.

SAVE WHAT YOU PLAY
Record notes, velocity, and sustain. Rename and replay takes, share MIDI, and export full-take Concert Grand M4A audio at normal speed for free. Your recordings and imported songs stay in your local library.

OPTIONAL PIANOFLOW PREMIUM
One purchase removes ads and unlocks Warm Studio and Bright Hall sound profiles, playback speed controls, loops, selected sections, saving trimmed copies, and lossless WAV export. Concert Grand, guided practice, basic recording and replay, MIDI sharing, and full-take Concert M4A export remain free. No subscription is required.

MADE FOR YOUR DEVICE
Use Larger Text, VoiceOver, Reduce Motion, and Increased Contrast. Controls use Liquid Glass on supported iOS versions, with clear native controls on earlier versions.

MIDI import supports Standard MIDI formats 0 and 1 with PPQN timing. Imported notation may be simplified; Rhythm coach grades when notes start, not how long they are held. External MIDI hardware and compatible adapters are sold separately.
whatsNew:
• Play on iPhone Duo with layouts for its inner and outer displays.
• Follow scrolling sheet music, use Rhythm coach, or import MIDI songs with parts for each hand.
• Record, replay, and share MIDI; full-take Concert Grand M4A export is included free.
• Optional one-time Premium removes ads and adds Warm Studio and Bright Hall sounds, playback speed, loops, section tools, trimmed copies, and WAV export.
• More legible active controls, Larger Text support, and recording reliability improvements.
